title: lookup_rules rejects the addressable stat-block kind
description:
Verified at main f4b3461. packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolLookupRules.ts inputSchema.properties.kind.enum lists sixteen kinds and omits 'stat-block', so ToolRegistry.invoke rejects the call with invalid_args before the tool body runs. The pack contains stat-block:avatar-of-death and stat-block:giant-fly, RulesRecordKind declares stat-block addressable, and packages/core/src/adventure/references.ts:134-141 permits encounter creature refs to resolve to 'creature' OR 'stat-block'. An authored module may therefore reference a stat-block the DM cannot look up.

Discovered by eshyra-jued (docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-29-existing-discovery-substrate-map.md defect 1), reproduced there through a real ToolRegistry.invoke. Blocker B1 of docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md: no stat-block discovery evidence is valid until this is repaired.
acceptance_criteria: lookup_rules accepts kind 'stat-block' and resolves stat-block:avatar-of-death / stat-block:giant-fly through the campaign stack; a test invokes the registry (not the tool body) for a stat-block ref; a test pins the schema enum against RulesRecordKind so a future kind cannot be silently unaddressable.
notes: Implemented canonical RULES_RECORD_KINDS shared by pack validation and lookup_rules schema; added ToolRegistry.invoke coverage for both committed stat-block refs and schema parity coverage. Verification: VITEST_MAX_FORKS=6 npm run verify:worktree (262 files passed, 4 skipped; 4711 tests passed, 19 skipped).
